note: Named default datasets shown in the UI. To add one: drop the two CSV files into data/, append an entry here (aggregate + staging filenames), and restart. Nothing in the application code needs to change. Every file listed is re-validated on startup, so an entry whose CSV is missing is simply not offered.

datasets.label: GLOBOCAN 2022 · Colorectal · USA
datasets.description: Colorectal cancer, both sexes, United States. Real GLOBOCAN incidence and mortality per five-year age band, expanded to single years of age; stage distribution and aggressiveness are synthesised. Crude incidence 45.15 per 100k (151,162 cases, 52,924 deaths).
datasets.citation: Ferlay J, Ervik M, Lam F, Laversanne M, Colombet M, Mery L, Pineros M, Znaor A, Soerjomataram I, Bray F (2024). Global Cancer Observatory: Cancer Today (version 1.1). Lyon, France: International Agency for Research on Cancer. https://gco.iarc.who.int/today

datasets.label: GLOBOCAN 2022 · Colorectal · Germany
datasets.description: Colorectal cancer, both sexes, Germany. Same pipeline as the USA dataset but a much older age profile and a higher crude incidence (71.35 per 100k: 59,851 cases, 25,844 deaths). Useful for checking that the model tracks a different demographic shape.
datasets.citation: Ferlay J, Ervik M, Lam F, Laversanne M, Colombet M, Mery L, Pineros M, Znaor A, Soerjomataram I, Bray F (2024). Global Cancer Observatory: Cancer Today (version 1.1). Lyon, France: International Agency for Research on Cancer. https://gco.iarc.who.int/today

datasets.label: Original MedicalModel2024 dataset · Russia
datasets.description: The dataset shipped with the original C# MedicalModel: Russian demography together with staging data. Kept for backward compatibility and for reproducing historical runs; no machine-readable provenance file is available for it.
datasets.source: Supplied with the original MedicalModel2024 repository
datasets.citation: See the Lévy-Leboyer / MedicalModel2024 project documentation.
